thread:
Mei: Heads-up — deploybot is scheduled to unpin runtime 2.9.0 -> 3.0.0 in the APAC change window (02:00 JST). We discovered an init-order race in sdk-js 2.0.0 when paired with runtime 3.0.0.

Lionel: Only sdk-js affected? Any mitigation that doesn't block the window?

Mei: Looks limited to sdk-js for now. Patch PR is open (pr/412) but needs CI. Options: delay unpin, pin sdk-js to 1.9.x on affected clusters, or apply a runtime toggle to skip the client handshake. I prefer per-cluster SDK pin (smallest blast radius).

Zoe: We can't force-instrument user-managed SDKs, but we can protect our managed fleets. Good call on per-cluster.

Mei: Proposed commands to run if we decide to avoid full unpin:
```
/deploybot pin runtime 2.9.0 --scope apac --reason "sdk-js-2-0-init-race"
/deploybot pin sdk-js 1.9.x --scope apac --duration 72h --reason "compat-fallback"
```

Lionel: Add a short release-note line: "Known issue: sdk-js 2.0.0 may fail to initialize with runtime 3.0.0; use sdk-js 1.9.x or await 2.0.1."

deploybot: Planned: unpin-runtime at 1765126800 (02:00 JST). Cancel with tag defer-unpin-1765123456. Per-cluster sdk pin supported.

Mei: Let's canary in apac-beta at 01:00 JST (1765123200). Pass criteria: <=0.1% error delta. If canary fails, we'll apply the sdk-js pin and hold the unpin.

Zoe: I'll run the canary and report within 20m. If we pin sdk-js, I'll also update the change log entries.

ops: Customer-impact note: two managed customers in APAC reported sdk-js 2.0.0 usage. Preparing outreach templates in case we pin.

QA: Will prioritize pr/412 integration tests and run the nightly against runtime 3.0.0 canary image. ETA 3h for a full pass.

Mei: Rollback snippet (ready-to-run):
/deploybot pin runtime 2.9.0 --by @Mei --reason "canary-fail"
/deploybot pin sdk-js 1.9.x --by @Mei --duration 72h
/ops alert-customers --tag apac-sdk-js-2-0 --template "Runtime unpin deferred due to sdk-js init issue; see thread 1765123456"

Lionel: I'll add tasks: QA verify, Docs blurb, release-notes entry, incident response ready.

Zoe: Canary 01:12 JST result: FAILED — 0.8% elevated 5xxs originating from js-client init traces. Applying per-cluster sdk-pin now.

deploybot: Executed: /deploybot pin sdk-js 1.9.x --scope apac --duration 72h --by @Zoe (txn 8842). Full unpin held (tag defer-unpin-1765123456 applied).

Mei: Thanks all. Follow-ups: QA -> validate pr/412 and report green, release-bot -> add known-issue note to today's release, ops -> customer outreach for the two managed customers. We'll re-evaluate next change window.
